source_summary: Ink-and-wash Chinese mountain landscape with misty distant peaks, jagged cliffs, dense dotted foliage, pines, rocky slopes, a lower pavilion/bridge complex, winding foreground walkway, and right-side pine grove. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: misty_distant_peaks
motifs.description: Isolate the pale gray background mountain silhouettes rising behind the left and middle landscape: layered pointed peaks, soft ridge forms, and atmospheric wash fading into open mist. Exclude the calligraphy at far left and the darker foreground trees and rocks.
must_preserve: blurred mist edges around peak silhouettes

motifs.name: left_foreground_grove_rocks
motifs.description: Isolate the dense grove on the left foreground hillside with clustered trunks, dotted leaf masses, pine-like fronds, dark shrubs, and broken rocks at the base. Include the visible slope line and rocky ledges directly supporting the trees, but not the lower pavilion roof.
must_preserve: ink wash shadows at tree bases
scattered black texture dots on stones

motifs.name: upper_center_overhanging_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the suspended rocky cliff band across the upper center, including jagged contour lines, hanging vegetation, dotted shrubs, and claw-like pine needles descending from the ledge. Exclude the distant peaks below and the large right cliff mass.
must_preserve: dry-brush gray wash on stone faces
light mist gaps between rock strokes

motifs.name: central_dense_wooded_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the central midground mass of dark trees and rocky terraces: a thick canopy of black ink foliage, pale trunks, stacked boulders, and ferns or pines along the ledges. Keep only this wooded cliff cluster and its immediate rock base.

motifs.name: right_high_cliff_waterfall
motifs.description: Isolate the tall right-side cliff with the pale vertical waterfall or stream-like striations, surrounding terraced rock faces, top shrubs, and sparse vegetation clinging to ledges. Exclude the lower right foreground pine grove and bottom bridge.
must_preserve: arched grass and pine strokes on ledges
soft wash indicating mist around the fall

motifs.name: lower_center_pavilion_scholar
motifs.description: Isolate the lower center riverside pavilion or covered bridge section with slanted roof plane, vertical railings, windows, posts, and the small seated scholar figure inside. Include the immediate supporting bank beneath it, but not the separate zigzag walkway to the right.
must_preserve: slanted roof geometry with fine parallel hatch lines
light gray wash under the structure

motifs.name: lower_right_zigzag_bridge
motifs.description: Isolate the winding lower-right bridge or walkway section crossing the foreground: angled platforms, rail posts, plank-like hatching, and the curve as it turns around rocks. Exclude the center pavilion and the right pine grove except where posts directly attach to the bridge.
must_preserve: curving bank outlines below the walkway
pale gray wash on bridge surfaces
broken ink accents at corners and supports

motifs.name: right_foreground_pine_grove_path
motifs.description: Isolate the right foreground grove beside the path: tall pines with layered needle fans, dark tree masses, pale trunks, scattered shrubs, rocks, and the small winding ground path beneath them. Exclude the red seal in the lower-right corner.

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
